cues.en: Hartman, what does this have to do with my house and my dog? Oh, okay. That's enough. I I wanna go home now. This is the last president to stand up to the Fed.

cues.en: president Kennedy signed executive order one one one one zero.
cues.zh: 肯尼迪总统签署了第11110号行政命令。

cues.en: This executive order empowered the US treasury to issue real money without the Fed. It would have worked.
cues.zh: 这项行政命令授权美国财政部绕开美联储发行真正的货币。这本可以奏效的。

cues.en: Kennedy's plan to dismantle the Federal Reserve machine had begun.
cues.zh: 肯尼迪拆解美联储机器的计划就此启动。

cues.en: Six months later, later, John F. Kennedy went to Dallas and never returned.
cues.zh: 六个月后，约翰·肯尼迪去了达拉斯，再也没有回来。

cues.en: No way.
cues.zh: 不可能。

cues.en: No way they could do that. The new president, Lyndon Johnson, threw out Kennedy's order. And since JFK,
cues.zh: 他们不可能这么干。新总统林登·约翰逊废除了肯尼迪的命令。而自肯尼迪之后，

cues.en: no president has dared confront the secret powers behind the Federal Reserve.
cues.zh: 再没有一位总统敢挑战美联储背后的秘密势力。

cues.en: They consolidate bigger and bigger banks, print more and more money accountable to no one, decimating our nation's wealth for the benefit of a few.
cues.zh: 他们整合越来越大的银行，印越来越多的钱，却无人问责，摧毁国家财富以惠及少数人。
